articles.summary: The development of recombinant proteins stands out as a major milestone in biotechnology over the past century. These proteins are synthesized within different types of platforms, known as expression or heterologous hosts, which can be either eukaryotic or prokaryotic. Commonplace platforms today are bacteria, yeast, insect, and mammalian cells.
